before.name: Napoleon Jones
before.description: Napoleon Jones is a US Navy veteran who recorded a police traffic stop in Sussex, Wisconsin, on May 4, 2025. Deputies subsequently stopped his vehicle, handcuffed him and took him to Waukesha County Jail. Reporting describes five hours in custody before release without citations or criminal charges. His federal civil-rights complaint alleges that the stop and arrest were retaliation for recording police. The complaint reproduces a sheriff's supervisor memorandum acknowledging that the traffic stop was unlawful and Jones could not be compelled to identify himself. Jones also alleges that deputies later used Flock license-plate searches to track his vehicle in retaliation for his complaint. Those retaliation claims are allegations in his civil lawsuit, not findings of a final judgment.
